title: Language is Scary when Over-Analyzed: Unpacking Implied Misogynistic Reasoning with Argumentation Theory-Driven Prompts
reasoning: The paper focuses on the detection of implicit misogyny (a form of social bias) using large language models. While misogyny is an ethical issue, the paper is an evaluation of safety and bias detection capabilities rather than a benchmark for religion, spiritual traditions, or formal moral and ethical systems.
